title: What are your working hours?
content: We are open Monday to Saturday from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM East Africa Time.

title: Muda wenu wa kazi ni saa ngapi?
content: Tunafanya kazi Jumatatu hadi Jumamosi kuanzia saa 2:00 asubuhi hadi saa 12:00 jioni (EAT).

title: Are you open on Sundays?
content: We are closed on Sundays and public holidays, but you can still send a message and we will respond the next working day.

title: Je, mnafunguliwa siku ya Jumapili?
content: Hatufanyi kazi siku ya Jumapili na sikukuu, lakini unaweza kutuma ujumbe na tutakujibu siku inayofuata ya kazi.

title: What are your delivery fees?
content: Delivery within town is 3,000 TZS, and upcountry deliveries cost 10,000 TZS.

title: Gharama za usafirishaji ni kiasi gani?
content: Usafirishaji ndani ya mji ni TZS 3,000, na kwa maeneo ya mikoani ni TZS 10,000.

title: How long does delivery take?
content: Deliveries within town usually take 1-2 business days, while upcountry deliveries take 3-5 business days.

title: Usafirishaji unachukua muda gani?
content: Usafirishaji ndani ya mji huchukua siku 1-2 za kazi, na kwa mikoani huchukua siku 3-5 za kazi.

title: Which areas do you deliver to?
content: We deliver within Mbeya town and to most regions across Tanzania through our upcountry delivery partners.

title: Mnasafirisha bidhaa maeneo gani?
content: Tunasafirisha bidhaa ndani ya mji wa Mbeya na pia kwa mikoa mingi Tanzania kupitia washirika wetu wa usafirishaji.

title: What payment methods do you accept?
content: We accept mobile money (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money), bank transfer, and cash on delivery.

title: Njia zipi za malipo mnazokubali?
content: Tunakubali malipo kwa njia ya simu (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money), uhamisho wa benki, na malipo pale unapopokea bidhaa.

title: Can I pay with cash on delivery?
content: Yes, cash on delivery is available in most areas we serve. Some upcountry orders may require partial prepayment.

title: Naweza kulipa nikishapokea bidhaa?
content: Ndiyo, malipo baada ya kupokea bidhaa yanapatikana katika maeneo mengi tunayohudumia. Baadhi ya oda za mikoani zinaweza kuhitaji malipo ya awali.

title: How do I place an order?
content: You can place an order by messaging us with the product name, quantity, and your delivery location, and our agent will confirm the details.

title: Ninawezaje kuweka oda?
content: Unaweza kuweka oda kwa kutuma ujumbe wenye jina la bidhaa, kiasi, na eneo lako la kupokelea, na wakala wetu atathibitisha maelezo.

title: Can I cancel my order?
content: Yes, orders can be cancelled before they are dispatched. Please contact us as soon as possible with your order details.

title: Naweza kufuta oda yangu?
content: Ndiyo, oda zinaweza kufutwa kabla ya kutumwa. Tafadhali wasiliana nasi haraka iwezekanavyo ukiwa na maelezo ya oda yako.

title: How can I track my order?
content: You can track your order by messaging us your order number, and we will update you on its current status.

title: Naweza kufuatilia oda yangu vipi?
content: Unaweza kufuatilia oda yako kwa kutuma namba ya oda, na tutakupa taarifa za hali ya sasa ya oda yako.

title: Is there a minimum order amount?
content: There is no fixed minimum order amount, though very small orders may have a higher relative delivery fee.

title: Kuna kiwango cha chini cha oda?
content: Hakuna kiwango maalum cha chini cha oda, ingawa oda ndogo sana zinaweza kuwa na gharama kubwa zaidi ya usafirishaji kwa uwiano.

title: What is your return policy?
content: Items can be returned within 3 days of delivery if they are damaged, wrong, or defective, provided they are unused and in original packaging.

title: Sera yenu ya kurudisha bidhaa ni ipi?
content: Bidhaa zinaweza kurudishwa ndani ya siku 3 baada ya kupokelewa iwapo zimeharibika, si sahihi, au zina kasoro, mradi hazijatumika na ziko katika ufungashaji wa awali.

title: How do I get a refund?
content: Once a return is approved, refunds are processed back to your original payment method or mobile money account within 5-7 business days.

title: Ninawezaje kupata pesa zangu zirudishwe?
content: Baada ya kuridhiwa kwa kurudisha bidhaa, pesa hurejeshwa kwenye njia yako ya awali ya malipo au akaunti ya simu ndani ya siku 5-7 za kazi.

title: What if I receive a damaged item?
content: Please contact us immediately with photos of the damaged item and your order number, and we will arrange a replacement or refund.

title: Nifanye nini nikipokea bidhaa iliyoharibika?
content: Tafadhali wasiliana nasi mara moja ukiwa na picha za bidhaa iliyoharibika na namba ya oda yako, nasi tutapanga ubadilishaji au kurejesha pesa.

title: Do products come with a warranty?
content: Warranty coverage depends on the product and manufacturer; electronics and appliances typically include a manufacturer warranty, which we can confirm at the time of purchase.

title: Bidhaa zina dhamana?
content: Dhamana inategemea aina ya bidhaa na mtengenezaji; vifaa vya elektroniki kwa kawaida huja na dhamana ya mtengenezaji, tunaweza kuthibitisha wakati wa ununuzi.

title: How can I contact customer support?
content: You can reach our support team through this chat, by phone, or by email, and we typically respond within a few hours during working hours.

title: Ninawezaje kuwasiliana na huduma kwa wateja?
content: Unaweza kuwasiliana na timu yetu ya huduma kupitia mazungumzo haya, simu, au barua pepe, na kwa kawaida tunajibu ndani ya masaa machache wakati wa saa za kazi.

title: How do I file a complaint?
content: You can share your complaint directly in this chat with your order details, and it will be escalated to a human agent if needed.

title: Ninawezaje kutoa malalamiko?
content: Unaweza kutoa malalamiko yako moja kwa moja hapa kwenye mazungumzo ukiwa na maelezo ya oda yako, na yatapelekwa kwa wakala wa kibinadamu ikihitajika.

title: Can I speak to a human agent?
content: Yes, at any point you can request to speak with a human agent and one will take over the conversation.

title: Naweza kuongea na mtu badala ya roboti?
content: Ndiyo, wakati wowote unaweza kuomba kuongea na wakala wa kibinadamu na atachukua mazungumzo.

title: Do I need an account to order?
content: You do not need to create an account to order; you can place an order directly through chat with your name and delivery details.

title: Nahitaji akaunti ili kuweka oda?
content: Huhitaji kufungua akaunti ili kuweka oda; unaweza kuweka oda moja kwa moja kupitia mazungumzo kwa kutumia jina lako na maelezo ya usafirishaji.

title: How do I register an account?
content: To register, share your full name, phone number, and preferred delivery location, and we will set up your customer profile.

title: Ninawezaje kujisajili akaunti?
content: Ili kujisajili, tuma jina lako kamili, namba ya simu, na eneo unalopendelea la kupokelea bidhaa, nasi tutaunda wasifu wako wa mteja.

title: What languages do you support?
content: Our assistant can respond in both English and Swahili, so feel free to write in whichever language is most comfortable for you.

title: Mnajibu kwa lugha zipi?
content: Msaidizi wetu anaweza kujibu kwa Kiingereza na Kiswahili, hivyo jisikie huru kuandika kwa lugha unayoipenda zaidi.

title: Do you offer discounts or promotions?
content: We occasionally run promotions and seasonal discounts; ask us about current offers and we will let you know what is available.

title: Kuna punguzo la bei au ofa?
content: Mara kwa mara tuna ofa na punguzo la msimu; tuulize kuhusu ofa za sasa nasi tutakujulisha zilizopo.

title: Do you have a loyalty or referral program?
content: We are building a loyalty program for repeat customers; for now, referring friends can qualify you for occasional referral bonuses.

title: Kuna mpango wa uaminifu au kupendekeza marafiki?
content: Tunaandaa mpango wa uaminifu kwa wateja wa mara kwa mara; kwa sasa, kupendekeza marafiki kunaweza kukustahilisha bonasi za mara kwa mara.

title: What happens if a product is out of stock?
content: If a product is out of stock, we will suggest a similar alternative or notify you as soon as it becomes available again.

title: Nini kikitokea bidhaa haipo stock?
content: Endapo bidhaa haipo stoo, tutapendekeza mbadala unaofanana au tutakujulisha mara itakapopatikana tena.

title: Can I request a product you don't currently list?
content: Yes, you can request a specific product and we will check with our sellers to see if it can be sourced for you.

title: Naweza kuomba bidhaa ambayo hamna kwenye orodha?
content: Ndiyo, unaweza kuomba bidhaa maalum nasi tutaangalia na wauzaji wetu kama inaweza kupatikana kwa ajili yako.

title: Can I get a receipt or invoice for my purchase?
content: Yes, a receipt or invoice can be sent to you by email or as a message once your order is confirmed and paid for.

title: Naweza kupata risiti ya ununuzi wangu?
content: Ndiyo, risiti inaweza kutumwa kwako kwa barua pepe au ujumbe mara oda yako itakapothibitishwa na kulipiwa.

title: How do I become a seller on your platform?
content: To become a seller, contact our support team with your business details and the product categories you would like to list.

title: Ninawezaje kuwa muuzaji kwenye jukwaa lenu?
content: Ili kuwa muuzaji, wasiliana na timu yetu ya huduma ukiwa na maelezo ya biashara yako na aina za bidhaa unazotaka kuuza.

title: What should I do if my payment fails?
content: If a payment fails, please try again or use an alternative payment method, and contact us if the amount was deducted but the order was not confirmed.

title: Nifanye nini malipo yakishindikana?
content: Endapo malipo yameshindikana, jaribu tena au tumia njia nyingine ya malipo, na wasiliana nasi ikiwa fedha zimetolewa lakini oda haijathibitishwa.

title: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
content: Yes, you can request an address change before your order is dispatched by messaging us with the new delivery details.

title: Naweza kubadilisha anwani ya kupokelea baada ya kuweka oda?
content: Ndiyo, unaweza kuomba kubadilisha anwani kabla oda haijatumwa kwa kutuma maelezo mapya ya usafirishaji.

title: Do you deliver on weekends?
content: We deliver on Saturdays; Sunday deliveries are generally not available except for pre-arranged urgent orders.

title: Mnasafirisha bidhaa wikendi?
content: Tunasafirisha bidhaa siku ya Jumamosi; usafirishaji wa Jumapili kwa kawaida haupatikani isipokuwa kwa oda za dharura zilizopangwa mapema.

title: How is my personal information used?
content: Your personal information is only used to process your order and deliver it to you, and is not shared with third parties without your consent.

title: Taarifa zangu binafsi zinatumikaje?
content: Taarifa zako binafsi zinatumika tu kuchakata oda yako na kuisafirisha kwako, na hazitolewi kwa wahusika wengine bila idhini yako.

title: Can businesses place bulk or wholesale orders?
content: Yes, businesses can place bulk or wholesale orders; please share the products and quantities needed so we can arrange special pricing.

title: Biashara zinaweza kuweka oda za jumla?
content: Ndiyo, biashara zinaweza kuweka oda za jumla; tafadhali tuma bidhaa na kiasi kinachohitajika ili tupange bei maalum.

title: What should I do if the AI assistant can't answer my question?
content: If the assistant cannot answer your question, it will forward your message to a human support agent who will assist you further.

title: Nifanye nini msaidizi wa AI asiweze kujibu swali langu?
content: Iwapo msaidizi hawezi kujibu swali lako, atapeleka ujumbe wako kwa wakala wa kibinadamu ambaye atakusaidia zaidi.
